name: Creamy Mushroom Chicken Over Roasted Spaghetti Squash

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 500°F and place the rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium spaghetti squash
227 g cremini mushrooms
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
½ lemon

instructions.primary_message: Trim off and discard ends of the squash; halve squash lengthwise and scrape out the seeds from each half. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt and pepper. Arrange the squash halves cut-side-down on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
extra virgin olive oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.
Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom.
Add flour to a plate. Dredge the chicken cutlets in flour, shake off excess, and add to the skillet. Pan-fry until golden brown and cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Remove to a clean plate.
Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, slice the mushrooms. Peel and mince garlic.
Return the skillet (with leftover oil from cooking) to medium heat. Add mushrooms, garlic, Italian seasoning, and salt. Cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms are tender, 3-4 minutes.
Add flour to the skillet and stir to coat mushrooms. Pour in broth, milk, and Dijon. Return chicken to the skillet and cook, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens, 3-4 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
118 ml chicken or vegetable broth
118 ml whole milk
½ tsp Dijon mustard

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves.
Remove skillet from the heat. Juice lemon into the skillet and add half of the parsley (reserving the rest for garnish); stir to combine.

Remove squash from the oven; allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes. Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands. (Use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand.)
To serve, divide spaghetti squash between bowls. Top with chicken and mushroom sauce. Garnish with remaining parsley and enjoy!
